title: Solutions Development Architect
description:
**Meet the Team**
 Security at Cisco is no longer a product you bolt on — it is table stakes, and it is a lifecycle, and our Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services team in Asia Pacific \& Japan is where that belief meets our largest Service Provider customers. We help Tier\-1 carriers, national operators, mobile network operators, and telco\-cloud/webscale providers across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN, and India transform their security architecture — infusing protection into the network fabric, embedding zero trust by design, and standing up a modern, AI\-driven Security Operations Center. We are a small, senior, high\-trust group of architects of record who operate at the intersection of deep networking and security, and who are trusted by CISOs and CTOs to set the security direction for some of the region's most complex networks. What is exciting is the scope: you own the security agenda for an entire vertical across four diverse markets, and you get to shape how an agentic, AI\-powered SOC and security\-by\-design come to life at carrier scale.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a senior Security Solutions Development Architect, you will drive the CX Security pre\-sales architecture and delivery strategy for highly complex, large\-scale groundbreaking engagements across APJ Service Provider accounts, acting as the security architect of record. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
   

  

**Security \& Service Provider Technical Domains**
 You Are Expected To Bring Architect\-level Expertise Across At Least Two Domains — Networking And Security Architecture — With Cross\-domain Fluency Over The Following
   

  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design \& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability \& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC \& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


**APJ Regional Context**
 This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree \+ 12 years of related experience, OR Master's degree \+ 8 years, OR PhD \+ 5 years, OR equivalent relevant work experience.
* Deep networking expertise with demonstrated ability to apply zero trust security design principles (verify explicitly, least\-privilege access, assume breach) to transform customer security architectures at Service Provider scale.
* Shown mastery of security\-by\-design (network segmentation/micro\-segmentation and infrastructure controls) AND the design of observability frameworks and a modern SOC for detection and response (data collection, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, federated search, and high\-fidelity detection use cases).
* Practical AI fluency for security: demonstrated experience designing AI\-driven detection, investigation, and response and building high\-fidelity, agentic/automation\-led SOC workflows.
* Deep technical pre\-sales experience AND professional services/delivery experience, holding required certifications: CCNP Service Provider (or CCNP Enterprise/equivalent) AND CCNP Security (or equivalent) AND CISSP (or equivalent senior security architecture certification).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise, or CCIE Security; and/or security architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.
* Zero trust / SOC and security\-analytics certifications (e.g., Splunk certifications, SANS/GIAC such as GCIH/GCDA), AI\-security credentials, and/or cloud\-security specializations (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Strong, fluent English (written and spoken) with the executive presence to influence at CISO/CTO/SVP\-and\-above level across diverse APJ markets.
* Recognized strategic influencer, comfortable shaping customer security vision and representing Cisco in industry forums and strategic alliances.
* Skilled at orchestrating the SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to deliver large\-scale, multi\-country Service Provider security transformations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

description:
**About Protsahan**
 Protsahan India Foundation works with 96,000\+ girls annually across Delhi’s slum communities, building pathways out of poverty through education, mental health support, and livelihoods training. As the organisation scales into a pan\-India field\-building model in 2026, the Executive Director’s office requires dedicated, high\-calibre support to manage a wide and demanding portfolio of administrative, regulatory, and coordination responsibilities.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Senior Administrative Executive will directly support the Executive Director in managing time\-sensitive administrative, regulatory, and coordination tasks that fall within the ED’s direct responsibility but do not require the ED’s personal judgement or presence to execute. This is a role for someone who takes ownership of tasks end\-to\-end, tracks details precisely, and follows through without repeated reminders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage and track all statutory, regulatory, and administrative filings, licenses, registrations, and renewals that fall under the ED’s direct responsibility, maintaining a live compliance and renewals calendar with no missed deadlines.
* Coordinate with government departments, vendors, consultants, and external agencies on behalf of the ED, following up, collecting documentation, and driving pending applications to closure.
* Manage the ED’s calendar, correspondence, and meeting preparation, including compiling briefing notes and background material ahead of key meetings.
* Draft, proofread, and format correspondence, documents, and presentations on behalf of the ED.
* Maintain organised, accessible records of all documentation handled, physical and digital, so that nothing is dependent on institutional memory alone.
* Support the ED in tracking action items arising from meetings, board interactions, and donor conversations, and follow up proactively until closure.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information relating to governance, compliance, and personnel matters.
* Take on other administrative work sitting under the ED’s purview as required.


**Candidate Requirements**
**Non\-negotiables**
* Impeccable attention to detail. This is the single most important requirement for this role. The ideal candidate double\-checks their own work as a habit, catches errors before anyone else does, and treats documentation accuracy as professional pride, not obligation.
* Process discipline. Follows documented processes precisely, without shortcutting steps or improvising on filings, checklists, or approval flows. Deviations are flagged and discussed, not decided unilaterally.
* 24\-hour turnaround on assigned tasks. Every task gets a status update within one working day, even if the update is that the task is blocked.
* Absolute discretion. Handles confidential documents and conversations without exception.


**Essential**
* Graduate degree in any discipline. Additional certification in office administration or business support is welcome but not required.
* At least 5 years of experience in an executive assistant, administrative coordination, or similar support role, ideally involving statutory or regulatory filings.
* Prior direct experience supporting a Founder, CEO, or ED.
* Demonstrated experience navigating government departments or regulatory processes (fire department, municipal bodies, FCRA, or statutory filings).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Office and Google Workspace.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment.


**Preferred**
* Prior experience working with or for a non\-profit, foundation, or mission\-driven organisation.
* Familiarity with FCRA compliance requirements, or willingness to learn quickly.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Regulatory and statutory filings under the ED’s purview are tracked, followed up, and closed on time, with no last\-minute surprises.
* Correspondence and documents prepared for the ED are accurate and ready to use without correction.
* Routine administrative and procedural work is handled end\-to\-end, freeing the ED to focus on judgement\-heavy work only ED can do.

title: Quality analyst and Trainer
description:
The QA \& Training Analyst is a senior individual contributor who owns two connected charters for DentalKart's CX function: quality assurance and agent capability building. This role audits chat and email interactions against SLA/CX standards, runs structured root\-cause analysis (ACPT — Agent / Customer / Process / Technology) on service failures, and closes the loop by designing and delivering the training interventions — onboarding, refreshers, and targeted coaching — needed to fix what the audits surface. The ideal candidate has enough tenure to independently run both QA and training charters, and to represent both in reviews with the CX Head.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 4–5 years of experience spanning QA, training, or both, ideally within e\-commerce/D2C customer support or a comparable high\-volume support environment.
* Demonstrated ability to independently run a QA charter — scorecard design, audit execution, calibration — without close supervision.
* Hands\-on training/facilitation experience — designing content and delivering it to agents, not just consuming training material.
* Strong command of CX metrics and terminology — FRT, ART, AHT, TAT, SLA, CSAT, NPS, deflection.
* Working proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for tracking, scorecards, and reporting.
* Familiarity with helpdesk/chat platforms such as Zoho Desk, Zoho SalesIQ, or equivalent (Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom).
* Comfortable working with root\-cause frameworks (ACPT or equivalent) and translating audit findings into training content and process recommendations.
* Strong written and verbal communication — able to deliver constructive feedback to agents and summarize findings for CX leadership.


**Benefits**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Own end\-to\-end QA audits of chat (Zoho SalesIQ) and email (Zoho Desk) interactions against defined scorecards, covering both accuracy and tone/handling.
* Track and report CX metrics — FRT, ART, AHT, TAT, SLA compliance, CSAT, NPS, bot containment/deflection — and publish audit reporting on a defined cadence.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on negative feedback and repeat contacts using the ACPT framework, separating agent\-level, process\-level, and technology\-level failures.
* Run calibration sessions across auditors/TLs to keep QA scoring consistent; own the QA scorecard and update it as processes evolve.
* Convert recurring QA findings into SOP updates and process/technical fix recommendations, in partnership with the CX Head and Ops.
* Design and deliver onboarding/induction training for new CX hires, covering product, process, tools, and communication standards.
* Build refresher and upskilling modules based on recurring QA gaps — e.g., scripted/no\-resolution responses, misjudged escalations, tool usage errors. Design SOP of the processes and do weekly training with the team.
* Run targeted, evidence\-based coaching for individual agents or teams flagged through QA audits or performance scorecards (KRA/KPI).
* Maintain a training calendar, content library (SOPs, playbooks, scenario guides), and track training effectiveness against post\-training QA scores and CSAT movement.
* Certify agents on new processes, tools, or product launches before they go live on the floor.

 anantam is a destination for India’s finest fashion labels, bringing together an evolving edit of established and emerging designers under one roof. We believe in celebrating Indian craftsmanship and creating a welcoming retail experience for all.

**STORE, PRODUCT \& OPERATIONS**

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE**

 — with an appreciation for design, craftsmanship, styling and contemporary Indian fashion.

 — confident in selling and converting opportunities into meaningful client relationships.
* **Discerning \& detail\-oriented** 
 — with an instinct for quality and a strong eye for presentation.
* **Disciplined \& accountable** 
 — organised, punctual and consistent in execution.

 — someone who takes initiative rather than waiting to be directed.
* **Service\-led** 
 — understanding that luxury is defined as much by how a client feels as by what they purchase.

**Company Overview**

 top of all existing discounts and can be transferred directly to a bank account, making

 CashKaro has raised over ₹250 Cr in funding from marquee investors including the late Mr.
 



 Ratan Tata, and has scaled to ₹600 Cr in revenues — growing over 70% in FY26\.
 



  





 Our sister platform, EarnKaro, is India's \#1 affiliate marketing platform. It empowers content
 



 creators, homemakers, students, and micro\-influencers to monetise their reach by sharing

 The group also operates BankKaro, enabling users to compare and apply for credit cards,
 



 loans, and other financial products — making smarter financial decisions accessible to all.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a Tele Caller you will be responsible for reaching out to customers and leads to promote
 



 BankKaro’s partnered credit card offerings, including SBI, Axis, HSBC, and other leading card providers. You will educate customers about card benefits, eligibility, offers, and application processes while managing follow\-ups and ensuring a smooth customer journey from initial outreach to application submission.
 



 The role requires strong communication, persuasion, follow\-up discipline, and atarget\-oriented approach in a fast\-paced sales environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Customer Outreach \& Product Promotion
 


* Make outbound calls to prospective customers and leads for credit card offerings.
* Pitch credit cards clearly by explaining benefits, eligibility criteria, rewards, and applicable offers.

* Handle customer queries and objections professionally.



 2\. Lead Follow\-up \& Conversion
 


* Follow up consistently with warm and cold leads to drive application submissions.
* Maintain regular communication with interested customers throughout the application journey.
* Identify customer intent and maximise lead\-to\-application conversion.
* Ensure timely follow\-ups and closure of assigned leads.



 3\. Application \& Documentation Support
 


* Guide customers through the credit card application process.
* Explain required documentation and assist customers with the submission process.
* Ensure customer and application details are captured accurately.
* Coordinate with internal teams wherever required to resolve application\-related issues.



 4\. Application Tracking \& Customer Updates

* Maintain accurate records of calls, customer interactions, and application stages.
* Follow up on pending applications and required documentation.
* Ensure a smooth onboarding experience for customers.



 5\. Target \& Performance Management
 


* Achieve assigned daily, weekly, and monthly calling and conversion targets.
* Maintain strong call quality and closure rates.
* Monitor individual performance metrics and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Adhere to defined sales, quality, and compliance processes.



  





**Must Have Qualifications** 



* 0–3 years of experience in telesales, telecalling, credit card sales, BFSI sales, or customer\-facing calling roles.
* Excellent verbal communication skills with fluency in English and Hindi.
* Strong persuasion, negotiation, and objection\-handling skills.
* Comfortable working in a target\-driven and fast\-paced environment.
* Strong follow\-up discipline and customer\-handling skills.
* Basic knowledge of Excel, CRM, or lead\-tracking systems.
* Good attention to detail while handling customer information and application details.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Previous experience selling or handling credit cards, particularly SBI, Axis, HDFC, or HSBC products.
* Understanding of basic credit card eligibility criteria such as salary, age, and CIBIL score.
* Familiarity with cashback, rewards, and credit card comparison products.
* Experience working in a BFSI, fintech, or financial services environment.



  





**Why Join CashKaro?** 



* Real Ownership, Real Impact — You're not a cog in a machine. You work directly on products and decisions that move the needle for a platform used by millions of Indians every day.
* Innovative Culture — No unnecessary layers, no committee lags. We move fast, back good ideas, and give people the space to build, experiment, and grow.
* Learning \& Development — Structured L\&D programs, cross\-functional exposure, and a team that believes your growth is the company's growth.
* Wealth Creation — ESOPs awarded to many team members, because when CashKaro wins, the people who built it should win too.
* Food, Sorted — Daily lunch and snacks in office. One less thing to worry about.
* Benefits That Actually Matter — Comprehensive medical insurance, Flexible Benefits Plan with tax benefits, wellness initiatives, and a workplace designed tosupport you.
* We Celebrate Everything — Festivals, birthdays, work anniversaries, life milestones. If it matters to you, it matters to us.
* Community, Not Just Colleagues — Team events, outings, dinner meetups, and the kind of in\-office culture where people actually like showing up.
* Diverse by Design — We believe the best ideas come from the most varied rooms.
* Different backgrounds, different perspectives — that's not a policy, it's how we operate.

title: Growth Associate - Dental
description:
**Looking for a Growth Associate to join Orvica Labs to help scale the Dental vertical.
 



  





 Orvica Labs develops Health One, an AI platform for clinics to run their day to day work on\- covering appointments, WhatsApp\-based patient communication, billing and clinical charting and much more. Our first clinical specialty is Dental, before we add other specialties in healthcare.
 



  





 The platform is currently deployed with a multi\-branch dental group in Delhi NCR.
 



  





 Why this might suit you
 



  





 If your future is in the business side of dentistry rather than at the clinical chair, this is a direct route in. You’ll build a working relationship with practice owners across Delhi NCR, learn what makes a clinic function in real life, and understand how dental businesses are actually run — knowledge that stays with you whatever you do next.
 



  





 How we work
 



  





 Field\-based, no fixed office; we do regular team meets, but you set your own days around meetings. You’ll learn something new most days, and the work is genuinely enjoyable. We work hard, but we also have lives — we don’t expect you to work weekends.
 



  





 What the job actually involves
 



  





 This is early\-stage work, and the brief is simple: put your best foot forward to bring good clinics onto the platform. Some days that’s a scheduled demo with a practice owner. Others it’s representing Orvica at an IDA branch meeting or a dental conference, sharing our work on the channels dentists actually read, following up on an enquiry, speaking to your own batchmates and seniors, or trying an approach nobody has tried before. Building relationships with dental supply reps and lab technicians is part of it too — they visit every clinic in NCR each week and know which practices are growing before anyone else does. If it brings in the right clinics, it’s in scope. And it goes without saying, we’re here to support you through it.
 



  





 You should also know that selling to clinics takes time. A doctor who likes the product on day one might still sign much later, after follow\-ups and demos for their partners and staff — that’s normal, and it isn’t a bad sign. Trust is what closes these conversations, and trust takes time to build; you can’t fake it. Not every conversation converts, and the ones that do often land long after you’d stopped expecting them to. The people who do well at this treat a “not right now” as a task for next month rather than a rejection, and they enjoy the long game: every conversation teaches you something about how these practices run, and that knowledge compounds whether or not that particular clinic gets onboarded.
 



  





 Compensation: Competitive Salary \+ Performance Incentive. All work travel fully reimbursed. Laptop provided.
 



  





 Requirements: BDS, 0–2 years’ experience. Based in Gurugram or Delhi NCR. Willing to travel across NCR.
 



  





 No clinical duties, no chairside hours. You’ll report directly to the founder.
 



  





 Send applications to divij@orvica.in \- and if you want to stand out, write briefly about your greatest wins and accomplishments, and why you will be a good fit for this role.**

title: 🚀 AUMChip is Building a 20-Member Elite Experience in Semiconductor | Quantum | Ai | Robotics | Space Team
description:
We are looking for 20 exceptional engineers, researchers, PhD scholars and top IIT students who want to work on something far beyond a conventional internship.
   

  

 What is AUMChip?
   

  

 AUMChip is building a deterministic compute architecture spanning:
   

 Quantum Computing × AI × Robotics × Space × Semiconductors
   

  

 Our work has progressed substantially beyond an idea stage. The current architecture has gone through extensive RTL verification and pre\-silicon implementation work, including RTL\-to\-GDS physical implementation, formal verification, gate\-level verification, FPGA emulation and multi\-platform validation.
   

  

 The next objective is to take this architecture through Indian semiconductor technology toward prototype silicon.
   

 India's SCL operates an 8\-inch, 180 nm CMOS fab and provides capabilities spanning synthesis, physical design, DRC/LVS, PEX, physical STA and GDSII release.
   

 SCL \+1
   

  

 🌐 Why AUMChip different ?
   

  

 AUMChip is not only a chip architecture.
   

 It is being developed around “.aum”, an AUMChip\-associated computing/data format and language ecosystem, with an IANA media\-type registration associated with the project. IANA maintains the global media\-type registration system.
   

 Iana
   

  

 One core. Multiple domains🚀
   

  

 The AUMChip architecture is designed to provide a common deterministic compute foundation for:
   

 AI • Robotics • Space • Quantum
   

  

 Rather than building four disconnected accelerators, our approach is to develop one verified core architecture that can be adapted across these workloads and hardware substrates.
   

  

 The architecture has already undergone extensive RTL verification, FPGA emulation and cross\-substrate validation across multiple implementation platforms. The next step is to take that verified architecture toward Indian semiconductor fabrication and physical silicon validation.
   

  

 Our ambition is to build an Indian sovereign compute stack — architecture → compiler → format/language → hardware → silicon.
   

  

 🇮🇳 The India opportunity
   

  

 We intend to work closely with India's emerging semiconductor ecosystem and explore opportunities with Indian government, semiconductor laboratories, research institutions and manufacturing partners.
   

 The objective is simple:
   

 Design in India → verify in India → fabricate in India → build IP from India.
   

  

 🏭 Physical infrastructure
   

  

 AUMChip's team also has access to an 18,000 sq. ft. industrial facility in Masuri Industrial Area, Phase 1, where we are preparing to establish a dedicated semiconductor/advanced hardware laboratory.
   

 This gives selected team members the opportunity to work not only on software simulations, but toward real hardware, laboratory validation and eventually silicon.
   

  

 💰 Equity / ESOP opportunity
   

  

 We are currently raising $18M Pre\-Series A to accelerate AUMChip's semiconductor, compute and R\&D roadmap.
   

  

 We intend to create an ESOP pool of up to 5% for the selected 20\-member technical team, subject to formal ESOP documentation, vesting and company approvals.
   

  

 Early contributors who join at this stage can potentially participate in the value created as AUMChip progresses from pre\-silicon architecture → prototype silicon → commercial deployment.
   

  

 🔬 Who are we looking for?
   

  

 Only 20 positions.
   

 Quantum Engineers
   

 Quantum Computing Researchers
   

 PhD Scholars / Research Scholars
   

 VLSI / ASIC Engineers
   

 RTL / Verilog / SystemVerilog Engineers
   

 Computer Architecture Researchers
   

 Quantum Error Correction Researchers
   

 FPGA Engineers
   

 Physical Design / RTL\-to\-GDS Engineers
   

 EDA / Verification Engineers
   

 AI Hardware Researchers
   

 Semiconductor Algorithm Researchers
   

 C/C\+\+ / Python Engineers
   

 IITs and other top engineering/research institutions preferred.
   

  

 Exceptional candidates from outside IITs are absolutely welcome if their technical ability is outstanding.
   

  

 Why join at this stage?
   

  

 Because early in a deep\-tech company is when the biggest technical impact is possible.
   

 You won't be joining to maintain someone else's product.
   

  

 You'll be joining to help build the architecture, tools, verification, hardware and silicon of an ambitious Indian semiconductor company from the ground up.
   

 20 people. One mission. Build something India can own.
   

  

 Early\-stage founding opportunity: Selected contributors will participate in the initial development phase with an ESOP opportunity of up to 5% collectively for the 20\-member team. Paid positions and fixed salaries will commence from January 1, 2027, based on role and formal employment/engagement terms.

title: Associate Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
The Associate \- Accounts Receivable is responsible for the Order\-to\-Cash activities of its Business Lines covering billing, collections, cash application, and revenue recognition and reporting — ensuring accuracy, timely recovery of receivables, and clear visibility of customer outstanding balances for the business.
   

  

 The role brings standardisation to customer\-level visibility of revenue, invoicing and outstanding balances, and holds ownership of collections performance for an assigned customer portfolio, including ageing, DSO and overdue exposure. It requires a sound understanding of the business and its revenue drivers, the ability to manage large data sets and present up\-to\-date insights, control over pricing in the revenue systems, and effective partnering with Sales and Account Management on outstanding invoices, billing queries and customer escalations.
   

  

**Requirements**
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
   

  

* Maintain up\-to\-date, detailed pricing data to support invoicing and revenue management
* Apply control checks on invoicing data across all revenue streams
* Participate in the end\-to\-end Accounts Receivable process, from invoice generation through to collection and cash application
* Prepare, review and issue customer invoices accurately and on schedule, ensuring supporting data, tariffs and contractual terms are correctly applied before dispatch, and resolving discrepancies prior to release
* Manage collections for an assigned customer portfolio: monitor ageing reports, follow up on overdue invoices through structured dunning, and escalate long\-outstanding or high\-risk accounts in line with the agreed escalation matrix
* Issue statements of account and payment reminders, and record committed payment dates and collection notes to maintain a reliable receivables and cash\-inflow forecast
* Perform cash application on a daily basis, allocating incoming receipts to the correct customer invoices and matching remittance advices accurately
* Interact with Sales and Account Management on outstanding invoices — sharing overdue positions, obtaining customer feedback, resolving billing queries and disputes, and jointly agreeing recovery actions on ageing accounts
* Coordinate and assist in year\-end finalisation and audits, providing AR schedules and supporting documentation


**Requirements**
 Minimum Education/Qualification: Bachelor of Commerce (CMA, CA, B. Com or BBA); accounting certifications an advantage.
   

  

 Min. Experience :
   

  

* 4\+ years' experience in accounts receivable, billing or order\-to\-cash
* Direct communication with customers on billing and collections matters


 Industry
   

  

* 
* Order\-to\-cash, billing, collections or revenue accounting environment
* 
* Maritime technology, shipping services or a transaction\-based business preferred


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Hands\-on experience across the end\-to\-end order\-to\-cash cycle: billing, collections and cash application
* ERP experience (NetSuite or equivalent), including the AR and billing modules
* Maintenance of pricing and tariff data in revenue systems, including approval controls
* Control over credit notes and amendments to issued invoices
* Cash application, remittance matching and clearing of unapplied, unidentified or short\-paid receipts
* Statements of account, structured dunning and escalation processes
* Revenue reconciliation between invoicing and operational data
* Monthly revenue reporting, budget deviation analysis and forecasting models
* Analytics and data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI) for AR, billing and revenue reporting
* Advanced Excel, with the ability to manage and interpret large data sets


 Languages : English (fluent)

title: Manager - User Journey & Experience
description:
**About Zyla (** 
 www.zyla.in
 **)** 





 Zyla Health is India’s highest\-rated personalized care management platform focused on improving health outcomes. Zyla enables care at scale for insurers and employers through its human\-assisted AI on the 24x7 conversational Zyla app (consistently rated 4\.7\+). Some of our clients include Aditya Birla, Max Life, Care Insurance, HDFC Ergo, IBM, Godrej, Jindal Steels, DHL, Tata Steel, AstraZeneca, Pfizer.
 





 Care implemented by Zyla spans across medical, physical and mental health needs, and powered by a complete in\-house team of Doctors and experts as well as our proprietary AI engines \- Athena, Lea and Iris. The care starts with a detailed health risk assessment of the population followed by personalized care journeys ranging from chronic disease management to wellness programs.
 




  





**Why will you love working with us?** 





 We are India's leading AI\-powered care management platform. Our vision is to be the de\-facto healthcare expert in every home, providing access to the most personalized \& real\-time care to improve the quality \& longevity of lives.
 





 Zyla takes a clinical approach to provide hyper\-personalized and real\-time care delivered by an able team of experienced doctors \& medical experts to improve the health outcomes of the user. We have the finest talent across technology, data science, medicine, and management, and a product with an NPS of \+70! We are one of the highest\-rated Medical apps on the
 
 Google Play store
 
 (4\.8\+ consistently) and have been recognized by Google across Google App Excellence, Launchpad, and APAC programs. Top\-notch investors from India and the USA support us.
 





 We proudly boast about our work culture, at the core of which lies user\-centricity and the highest quality of empathy. At Zyla, you will meet the diverse talent that has come from the most reputed institutes and work organizations. Together, we set out to build the future of healthcare in India.
 




  





**Job Summary:** 





 As a User Journey \& Experience Designer, you will be responsible for understanding how a user interacts with Zyla at every stage of their journey — from discovering and onboarding onto the platform to engaging with our health programs, interacting with healthcare professionals, attending physical touchpoints and continuing their journey post\-intervention. 
 




  





**How you will make an impact:** 




**1\. Design End\-to\-End User Journeys** 



* Map complete end\-user journeys across different Zyla products and health programs.
* Understand user needs, motivations, pain points and drop\-off points at every stage.
* Design seamless journeys across
 
**pre\-service, service and post\-service interactions** 

 .
* Identify opportunities to improve user engagement, adoption, retention and overall experience.



**2\. Digital Experience – Zyla App** 



* Design user flows, journeys and experiences across the Zyla app.
* Translate user problems into intuitive and simple product experiences.
* Create wireframes, journey maps, prototypes and experience concepts.
* Identify friction points within existing journeys and recommend improvements.
* Partner with Product and Tech teams to take experiences from concept to implementation.



**3\. Physical \& Human Touchpoints** 



* Design experiences for users interacting with Zyla offline — including health camps, consultations, health assessments, wellness programs and other physical touchpoints.
* Map the complete offline experience, including registration, communication, waiting, interaction, service delivery and follow\-up.
* Ensure that physical experiences connect seamlessly with the digital/app experience.
* Think through operational realities while designing user\-centric experiences.



**4\. User Research \& Insights** 



* Conduct user interviews, surveys, usability testing and other research to understand user behaviour.
* Use qualitative and quantitative insights to identify experience gaps.
* Translate user feedback and behavioural data into actionable journey improvements.



**5\. Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Clinical teams, Nutritionists, Operations and Customer Success.
* Bring the
 
**user perspective** 

 into product and business discussions.
* Balance user needs with clinical requirements, business objectives and operational feasibility.
* Clearly communicate the rationale behind journey and experience decisions.



**6\. Measure \& Improve** 



* Define and track experience\-related metrics such as activation, engagement, drop\-offs, completion rates and retention.
* Analyse existing user journeys and continuously identify improvement opportunities.
* Run experiments and iterate based on data and user feedback.



  





**We are looking for people who:** 



* 5\+ years of experience in UX Design, Product Design, Customer Experience, Service Design or User Journey Design.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end user journey mapping and experience design.
* Experience designing digital products, preferably mobile apps.
* Ability to think beyond UI and understand the complete experience surrounding a product/service.
* Experience designing journeys involving both digital and physical/human touchpoints is a strong advantage.
* Strong user research and problem\-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and taking ownership of problems from identification to implementation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Think in journeys, not just screens.
* Constantly ask, “What is the user experiencing at this point?”
* Can simplify complex healthcare journeys into intuitive experiences.
* Are equally comfortable thinking about an app screen and what happens when a user walks into a physical health camp.
* Enjoy solving ambiguous problems and building something from scratch.
* Can balance user experience, business objectives and operational feasibility.



  





**What we offer:** 



* Opportunity to directly work on a very innovative product that has a big societal impact.
* Opportunity to work with a cross\-functional team consisting of leading medical brains, tech geeks, operations gurus.
* You'll have the opportunity to shape how thousands of users experience healthcare — not just through an app, but across the
 
**entire Zyla ecosystem of digital, clinical and human interactions** 

 .

title: Workplace Coordinator
description:
**What this job involves:**
 As a Workplace Coordinator, you'll be the face of exceptional service delivery for one of our most valued clients, creating an environment where people can do their best work every day. In this role, you'll coordinate and oversee soft services operations—from janitorial cleaning and waste management to hospitality services, and workplace amenities—ensuring every touchpoint reflects the highest standards of professionalism and care. You'll act as the primary liaison between our client, service providers, and building occupants, conducting daily inspections, managing vendor performance, and solving problems before they arise. At JLL, we are collectively shaping a brighter way for our clients, ourselves and our fellow employees, and this position puts you right at the heart of that mission. What sets JLL apart is our culture of collaboration, locally and across the globe, and you'll experience this firsthand as you partner with colleagues, contractors, and stakeholders to deliver seamless workplace experiences. We embrace more innovative ways of working and prioritize opportunities to strengthen and advance your career, giving you exposure to integrated facilities management, sustainability initiatives, and the commercial real estate industry's most forward\-thinking practices.
   

  

 What your day\-to\-day will look like:
   

  

* Coordinate daily delivery of soft facilities services including janitorial cleaning, waste removal, recycling programs, restroom supplies, pest control to maintain a pristine workplace environment
* Conduct daily walk\-throughs and quality inspections across office spaces, common areas, restrooms, pantries, meeting rooms, and cafeteria using established checklists and documentation standards
* Serve as day\-to\-day liaison with soft services contractors and vendors, monitoring performance, ensuring adherence to scope of work, and escalating issues as needed
* Manage workplace amenities including coffee stations, water dispensers, pantry supplies, break room provisions, and vending services to ensure all areas are well\-stocked and organized
* Respond to occupant service requests through CMMS or workplace apps, prioritizing and dispatching cleaning, restocking, and amenity\-related work orders while tracking completion and satisfaction
* Oversee waste management and recycling programs, monitor collection schedules, track waste diversion metrics, and support sustainability initiatives aligned with client environmental goals
* Schedule and coordinate pest control services, special cleaning projects, and seasonal activities including deep cleans
* Maintain inventory of cleaning supplies, restroom consumables, and amenity provisions, monitoring usage patterns and processing purchase orders to ensure adequate stock levels
* Generate inspection reports highlighting deficiencies, corrective actions, and service performance trends to support data\-driven decision making and continuous improvement


 Required qualifications:
   

  

* Associate's degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, or Hospitality
* 3–5 years of experience in facilities coordination, soft services management, building operations, or commercial office environments
* Experience with workplace experience platforms, employee apps, or integrated workplace management systems (IWMS)
* Strong organizational skills with proven ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and vendor relationships simultaneously
* Excellent attention to detail and quality consciousness with commitment to maintaining exceptional workplace environment standards
* Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with customer service orientation and professional demeanor
* Proficiency in CMMS or work order management systems and Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel)
* Hands\-on approach with willingness to conduct inspections, walk buildings extensively, and address issues directly throughout the day

**EY – Technology Assurance Senior Consultant (Japanese Speaker)**
 Technology Assurance provides independent assurance and risk advisory services focused on evaluating information technology, systems, processes, and controls that support business operations and financial reporting. Our services help organizations build trust, manage risk, and meet regulatory and contractual expectations. Engagements span assurance and risk advisory work and vary in scope and complexity.
   

  

 As a Japanese speaking Technology Senior Consultant, you will play a critical role in delivering end to end Technology Assurance engagements, interacting directly with Japanese clients, leading key workstreams, and collaborating with different engagement teams. You will apply strong technical expertise, professional judgment, and cultural awareness to deliver high quality outcomes.

The work includes financial audit IT support, SOC/SSAE engagements, IT governance and risk management, ERP and system controls, cybersecurity, and data and analytics.

* Proactive, detail oriented, and quality focused mindset.

* Prior experience as IT Auditor, Technology Risk Consultant, IT Compliance Analyst, Information Security Consultant, Financial Auditor or in similar roles.

* Flexibility to work extended hours during peak periods or critical engagement phases.


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment.
* Opportunities to work with EY technology risk practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. * Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.

**Global Managed Service – Privileged Identity and access Management – Senior**
 The Senior CyberArk Operations Support Analyst is a key member of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, responsible for the advanced support and management of the CyberArk infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of PAM principles, CyberArk architecture, and cybersecurity best practices. The Senior Analyst will lead initiatives to enhance security, streamline processes, and ensure the stability and integrity of privileged account management systems
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Lead the administration and advanced support of the CyberArk PAM solution, including complex troubleshooting, policy management, and platform optimization.
* Design and implement enhancements to the CyberArk infrastructure to improve security, efficiency, and compliance with industry standards.
* Oversee the onboarding of new accounts, platforms, and integrations into the CyberArk environment, ensuring adherence to strict security guidelines.
* Conduct regular system audits to identify potential vulnerabilities and recommend remediation strategies.
* Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on best practices and technical challenges.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to support enterprise\-wide cybersecurity initiatives and projects.
* Manage the response to critical incidents involving privileged accounts, including root cause analysis and preventive measures.
* Stay abreast of emerging threats and technologies in the PAM space and evaluate their impact on the organization.
* Lead the planning and execution of system upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities, minimizing disruption to business operations.
* Support compliance and regulatory activities by providing expertise and documentation as needed.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive disaster recovery and business continuity plan for the CyberArk infrastructure, ensuring minimal downtime and quick restoration of services in the event of an outage.
* Collaborate with the cybersecurity architecture team to design and implement a robust privileged access management strategy that aligns with the organization's overall security posture.
* Lead security incident investigations related to privileged accounts, including forensic analysis, and collaborate with the incident response team to develop a coordinated response plan.
* Proactively monitor the CyberArk environment for unusual activities and potential threats using advanced security tools and techniques.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for CyberArk within the organization, providing insights and recommendations to senior management on PAM\-related matters.
* Participate in vendor management, including evaluating potential software solutions, negotiating contracts, and managing relationships with CyberArk and other security vendors.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by regularly reviewing and updating CyberArk policies and procedures to reflect the evolving threat landscape and business needs.
* Facilitate cross\-training and knowledge sharing sessions within the team to ensure redundancy in critical skill sets and promote a culture of continuous learning.
* Engage with the broader cybersecurity community to stay informed about new vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and defense mechanisms related to privileged access management.
* Influence and enforce security policies and procedures across the organization, ensuring that privileged access is managed in accordance with best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Assist in budget planning and management for the CyberArk operations team, including forecasting future needs for resources, tools, and training.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Advanced knowledge of CyberArk PAM solutions, with relevant certifications such as CyberArk Certified Delivery Engineer (CDE), Defender, or Sentry.
* Proven experience in managing complex CyberArk environments, including components such as EPV, CPM, PSM, and AIM.
* Strong understanding of network security, identity and access management (IAM), and related technologies (e.g., SIEM, firewalls, multi\-factor authentication).
* Expertise in scripting and automation to streamline operations and incident response.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Leadership qualities and experience in mentoring or managing junior staff.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey technical information to non\-technical stakeholders


**Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
   

  

**Work Requirements:**

* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required

title: Manager - IT Infrastructure & Cloud Services
description:
**About Milliman**
 Independent for over 70 years, Milliman delivers market\-leading services and solutions to clients worldwide. We help companies address complex challenges in retirement funding and healthcare financing, risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics, and business transformation. Through a diverse team of professionals—actuaries, clinicians, technologists, and administrators—we provide expertise across employee benefits, investment consulting, healthcare, life insurance and financial services, and property and casualty insurance.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Milliman Global Corporate Services (GCS) is seeking an experienced and dynamic Manager, IT Infrastructure \& Cloud Services to partner with US\-based peers to develop a shared strategy and lead a team of engineers in India responsible for delivering and operating secure, scalable infrastructure and cloud platforms supporting Milliman’s global practices. This role will be a local peer to the existing Manager, IT Operations \& M365 in India. The two roles will work closely to ensure end\-to\-end operational excellence across 24x7 global services.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on leader who can drive cloud adoption, modernize infrastructure, enable data platforms, improve processes, foster inclusive collaboration, and communicate clear business value to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 This role focuses on infrastructure platform engineering, cloud services, DevOps enablement, and supporting the data platform and AI\-enabling capabilities.
   

  

 This role reports to the GCS IT Director of Infrastructure, Operations and Cloud Services (IOC).
   

  

**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership and People Management**
* Lead and develop a high\-performing team of infrastructure and cloud services engineers.
* Set clear goals and KPIs in collaboration with all IOC leadership, provide mentorship and coaching, and conduct performance evaluations.
* Hire and onboard team members; build diverse, inclusive teams and a culture of psychological safety and continuous learning.
* Establish staffing plans, on\-call rotations, and coverage models that support 24x7 global operations in conjunction with broader IOC team.


**Infrastructure Platform Engineering**
* Manage engineers who support on\-premises, virtualized, and cloud infrastructure (servers, storage, containers) ensuring high availability, reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Drive local team capacity planning, patching, configuration management, backup and recovery, and disaster recovery.
* Ensure team executes on infrastructure\-as\-code and automation (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) vision to improve consistency and speed.


**Cloud Services and Data Enablement**
* Oversee engineers who manage and optimize multi\-cloud platforms (AWS and Azure), including landing zones, IAM, networking, security, and guardrails.
* Ensure team executes on cloud cost management and FinOps practices for transparency, optimization, and budgeting.
* Align with broader IOC team to evaluate and pilot emerging technologies for practical, secure, and compliant business use cases; articulate value and adoption paths.


**DevOps and CI/CD Enablement**
* Partner with DevOps resources in the design and operation of secure, resilient CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, and GitOps workflows.
* Align with broader IOC team to establish SLOs/SLAs, observability (monitoring, logging, tracing), incident response, and post\-incident reviews.
* Ensure global collaboration to improve existing runbooks, automation, and standards to reduce issues and improve meantime to recovery.


**Networking and Voice Infrastructure**
* Oversee engineers that manage infrastructure elements of WAN/LAN, VPN, DNS, load balancers, and cloud networking.
* Ensure uptime of integrations between voice/communication platforms and cloud/infrastructure services in collaboration with relevant teams.


**Security, Compliance, and Governance**
* Partner with Information Security to implement and maintain security controls (MFA, RBAC, encryption, key/secrets management, vulnerability management).
* Lead engineers that embed policy\-as\-code and compliance guardrails; support audits and regulatory requirements across geographies.
* Collaborate with architects to refine standards, implement technology roadmaps while ensuring consistent and secured implementations.


**Service Delivery and Operations**
* Provide “follow the sun” service delivery and incident response for infrastructure and cloud platforms; track and report on performance metrics, SLAs, and operational KPIs.
* Drive problem, change, and configuration management aligned with ITIL best practices.
* Identify and implement process improvements that enhance efficiency, reliability, and customer satisfaction.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement**
* Collaborate with practices, product teams, data teams, InfoSec, and global IT groups to align platform capabilities with business needs.
* Communicate complex technical topics clearly to non\-technical leaders; build business cases and executive\-ready narratives that link technology investments to outcomes.
* Partner closely with peer IOC managers to ensure seamless end\-to\-end service integration across global operations.


**Qualifications Required**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
* 10\+ years of experience managing cloud services and infrastructure in a global context, with at least 5\+ years leading engineering teams.
* Demonstrated knowledge of data center, virtualization and cloud networking including, but not limited to: VPN, load balancing, DNS, and cloud network architectures.
* Solid understanding in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP; knowledge of cloud\-native services, IAM, networking, security, and cost optimization.
* Strong grasp of observability, incident and change management, and ITIL\-aligned operations.
* Proven track record driving process improvements, standardization, and operational excellence across distributed teams.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels.
* Demonstrated inclusive leadership, talent development, and team\-building skills across diverse, cross\-cultural teams.


**Qualifications Preferred**
* Master’s degree in a related field.
* Experience operating in multinational organizations and supporting 24x7 global services.
* Knowledge and understanding in containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), infrastructure\-as\-code, automation, and CI/CD.
* Relevant certifications and training in AWS/Azure/GCP professional\-level, ITIL, project management, Databricks, or security certifications.
* Familiarity of Databricks and AI/ML platform enablement, emerging AI technologies (e.g., OpenAI, Google PaLM) and enterprise adoption patterns.

title: Product Support Engineer
description:
We are looking for a
 **Product Support Engineer for M365 \& Power Platform** 
 domain who combines strong hands\-on
 **technical skills** 
 with a
 **product mindset** 
 .
 



  





 This is not a traditional helpdesk or ticket\-based support role. You will own the day\-to\-day health, usability, support, and continuous improvement of business applications and solutions built on
 **Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Apps, and Power Automate** 
 .
 



  





 The right person will be comfortable troubleshooting production issues, understanding how users interact with a solution, identifying recurring problems, evaluating enhancement requests, working with developers and business stakeholders, and driving issues through to resolution.
 



  





 You should think beyond
 **“How do I fix this issue?”** 
 and ask
 **“Why did this happen, how can we prevent it, and how can we make the product better for the user?”** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Product Support \& Ownership** 



* Own day\-to\-day support and operational health of
 **M365, SharePoint, Power Apps, and Power Automate solutions and overall Microsoft ecosystem.**
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for application and platform\-related issues.
* Triage incidents, determine business impact and priority, and drive issues through resolution.
* Perform root\-cause analysis for recurring or complex issues and recommend permanent fixes.
* Monitor application behavior, workflows, integrations, permissions, and user experience.
* Identify opportunities to improve application reliability, usability, and performance.
* Maintain clear documentation of known issues, resolutions, dependencies, and support procedures.



  





**2\. Product Mindset \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Understand the business purpose and user journey behind each application or solution.
* Evaluate enhancement requests based on business value, user impact, effort, and technical feasibility.
* Work with business stakeholders to clarify requirements and translate them into actionable technical changes.
* Maintain and prioritize a product/support backlog of defects, enhancements, and technical improvements.
* Identify recurring user pain points and proactively recommend improvements.
* Participate in solution design discussions with a focus on usability, maintainability, scalability, and long\-term supportability.
* Challenge requirements when a simpler or better solution is possible.



  





**3\. Microsoft 365 \& SharePoint** 



* Support and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 services including Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint Online.
* Manage SharePoint sites, lists, libraries, pages, permissions, and configurations.
* Troubleshoot SharePoint functionality, access, workflow, and performance issues.
* Develop and maintain SharePoint solutions using
 **SPFx, PowerShell, and PnP** 
 .
* Support SharePoint governance, permissions, information architecture, and site structures.
* Identify and implement improvements to existing SharePoint solutions.



  





**4\. Power Apps \& Power Automate** 



* Support, troubleshoot, and enhance business applications built using
 **Power Apps** 
 , including Canvas and Model\-driven apps.
* Troubleshoot and maintain
 **Power Automate** 
 workflows and integrations.
* Analyze failed flows, performance issues, connector issues, permissions, and data\-related problems.
* Work with SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, Teams, and other data sources.
* Make controlled changes to applications and workflows based on approved requirements.
* Test enhancements and fixes before production deployment.
* Ensure solutions remain maintainable and aligned with Power Platform best practices.



  





**5\. Incident, Change \& Release Management** 



* Manage incidents, service requests, defects, and enhancement requests through
 **Azure DevOps (ADO)** 
 or similar tools.
* Participate in prioritization, sprint planning, and release activities where applicable.
* Coordinate with developers, QA, business analysts, and stakeholders to resolve issues and deliver enhancements.
* Perform functional validation and support UAT for application changes.
* Maintain appropriate change and release documentation.
* Follow issues through deployment and post\-release validation.



  





**6\. User \& Stakeholder Support** 



* Work directly with business users and stakeholders to understand issues and requirements.
* Explain technical issues and solutions in clear, business\-friendly language.
* Provide guidance and best practices to users without simply treating every request as a ticket.
* Identify training or usability gaps that may be contributing to support issues.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders and establish credibility as the person who understands both the technology and the business problem.



  





**7\. Documentation \& Knowledge Management** 



* Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Document recurring issues, root causes, workarounds, and permanent resolutions.
* Maintain application inventories, dependencies, ownership information, and support documentation.
* Help build a knowledge base that reduces repetitive support requests.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 6–8 years of relevant experience in Microsoft technologies, application support, product support, or a similar role.
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* **Microsoft 365**
* **SharePoint Online**
* **Power Apps**
* **Power Automate**
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Experience supporting business applications in a production environment.
* Experience with
 **SharePoint development using SPFx, PowerShell, and PnP** 
 .
* Experience integrating Power Platform with
 **SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, Teams** 
 , and other data sources.
* Experience working with
 **Azure DevOps (ADO)** 
 or similar ticketing/backlog management tools.
* Good understanding of M365 security, permissions, governance, and administration.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable working directly with business users and stakeholders.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* **Product mindset:** 
 Thinks about the complete user experience, not just the individual ticket or technical task.
* **Ownership:** 
 Takes an issue from identification through resolution and post\-resolution validation.
* **Curiosity:** 
 Wants to understand why something is happening rather than applying a quick workaround.
* **Problem solver:** 
 Comfortable investigating ambiguous or complex production issues.
* **Business orientation:** 
 Understands the business impact of technical decisions.

**events, experiences, community building, partnerships and brand engagement**

**social media, influencers and community\-building**

description:
**Key Highlights** 




  




* **Position** 
 : Intern, Creative Strategy
* **Location**

**About Airblack \& Zudo:** 




  





 Airblack is India’s largest alternate skilling platform, helping people become microentrepreneurs and creators. Our mission is to help the next 100 million people in the workforce get access to meaningful opportunities.
 



  





 We currently operate in sectors such as beauty, fashion, nutrition, digital \& home businesses, impacting over 1M learners every month. Our flagship school in the beauty space is India’s \#1 Beauty Academy brand, with an alumni base of over 40,000 entrepreneurs in 300\+ cities in India. Our apps consistently rank in top 10 education apps in India with 1M\+ users and 40M\+ minutes of learning content being consumed every month.
 



  





 Airblack has raised Rs. 100cr\+ from marquee investors such as Elevation Capital, Info Edge Ventures, Michael \& Susan Dell Foundation, Blume Founders Fund and Better Capital, and leading angels such as Vidit (Meesho), Kunal (CRED), Deepinder (Zomato), Harshit \& Shashank (Razorpay) and so on.
 



  





 One of our new products, Zudo, is now India’s fastest growing apps in the skilling / content space. Built with the mission of helping people get access to meaningful opportunities, it offers microcourses across Social media, Beauty, Fashion and other digital businesses. Few numbers:
 



  




* 10M downloads / 1M MAU / growing 100% QoQ
* Over 50,000 businesses already launched in beauty / fashion / nutrition / digital sectors



  





**What would you be doing?** 




  




* **Script Generation at Volume:** 
 This is the core of the role. You'll be responsible for producing a high volume of ad scripts every week. Scripts need to be on\-brand, culturally relevant, trend\-aware, and built to perform on Instagram and YouTube. Speed and quality aren't a tradeoff here \- both are non\-negotiable. If you've never operated at this kind of volume before, this role will teach you what creative velocity actually means.
* **AI\-Powered Creative Production:** 
 You'll use AI tools end\-to\-end to go from script to final video \- including voiceover, avatar generation, captions, and editing. We're not looking for someone who's just curious about AI; we want someone who already lives in these tools. Experience with platforms like HeyGen, Higgsfield, Kling, ElevenLabs, Runway, CapCut, or similar is a strong signal. Hands\-on output matters more than theoretical familiarity.
* **Data\-Backed Creative Thinking:** 
 Great creative instinct is only half the job. You'll work closely with the performance marketing team to read dashboards, identify what's working, and translate signals into sharper creative decisions. When something underperforms, your first move is to look at the data \- not your gut. This means designing structured experiments (hooks, CTAs, visual styles), tracking results, and iterating with intent.
* **Research \& Trend Intelligence:** 
 You'll lead primary research (customer interviews, surveys) and secondary research (competitor ad libraries, cultural trends) to stay ahead of what resonates with our Tier 2/3 audience. You spot what's about to trend before it does \- and you move fast enough to use it.



  





**What makes you a suitable candidate?** 




  




* Recent grad or final year student \- background matters less than output
* Demonstrated interest in the creative field \- a portfolio, side project, or body of work that shows you've been doing this on your own
* Hands\-on experience with AI video/creative tools (HeyGen, Higgsfield, Kling, ElevenLabs, Runway, CapCut AI, or similar) would be a massive plus
* Native fluency in internet culture \- you know what's trending before it trends
* Comfortable with data \- can read a performance dashboard and act on it
* High ownership and accountability \- you don't wait to be told twice, and you take the outcome personally
* Previous experience with content creation is a massive plus



  





**Why should you join Airblack?** 




  




* **Skilling with a difference:** 
 We are one of the very few education companies in India that have been able to do all the following things together: deliver outcomes, stay lean (under 50 people), raise funds in a down market from top investors, have an infinite runway, and lead a completely new whitespace. Get the opportunity to be the face of a new era in the education \& skilling sector in a high\-skin\-in\-the\-game leadership role
* **Experimentation \& Build:** 
 We have a culture of rapid experimentation, freedom to fail \& iterate, and owning scale\-up through process building
* **Thriving Market** 
**Opportunity** 
 : We are building in a whitespace with massive opportunity \& headstart \- India has 15 million people entering the workforce every year and less than half a million jobs. Your impact will help create a dent in India’s future
* **Work with a stellar team** 
 : Great missions require great people \- and we are fortunate to have some of the smartest and nicest people supporting us in our journey. Our team comprises ex\-entrepreneurs, VCs, and operators from places such as Goldman Sachs, Paytm, Oyo, Bain \& Co., BCG, Urban Company, top IITs and so on

title: Senior Payroll Specialist
description:
**Job Title: International Payroll and Compliance Specialist** 




  





**Location: New Delhi** 




**Function: Total Rewards \& Payroll** 




**Reporting To: Head \- Total Rewards** 




**Experience: 5\+ Years (Mandatory International Payroll Experience)** 




 We are looking for an experienced International Payroll \& Compliance Specialist to manage payroll, compliance, taxation, and employee benefits across multiple countries. The role will support payroll operations in the US, UAE and other geographies ensuring employees are paid accurately, on time, and in compliance with local laws and regulations.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in international payroll governance, regulatory compliance, payroll taxation, statutory filings, benefits administration, and payroll reporting. This role requires a detail\-oriented professional who can effectively partner with HR, Finance, payroll vendors, and external consultants to ensure seamless and compliant payroll operations globally.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




  





**Global Payroll Operations** 



* Manage end\-to\-end payroll processing across geographies like United States, United Arab Emirates etc.
* Process Monthly payroll, Off\-cycle payrolls, Variable pay payouts, Annual bonus payouts, Incentive and commission payments, Arrears and retro\-payments, Salary revisions, Full \& Final (FnF) settlements, Employee reimbursements and deductions
* Ensure payroll accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with country\-specific regulations and payroll calendars.



  





**Compliance \& Statutory Administration** 



* Ensure compliance with country\-specific payroll, labor law, taxation, social security, pension, and employment regulations.
* Manage statutory filings and remittances across all assigned countries.
* Monitor regulatory changes and implement payroll process updates to maintain compliance.
* Support internal and external audits related to payroll and statutory compliance.



  





**Taxation \& Statutory Filings** 



* Manage payroll taxation, reconciliations, and reporting requirements across global geographies.
* Ensure accurate calculation, withholding, and submission of Federal, State, and Local Taxes
* Social Security Contributions, Pension Contributions, Employment Taxes, Payroll\-related statutory deductions
* Coordinate with external tax and compliance partners to ensure regulatory compliance.



  





**Benefits \& Retirement Administration** 



* Administer country\-specific employee benefit programs, including 401(k) Plans (US), End of Service Benefits (EOSB) (UAE), Other statutory and non\-statutory employee benefits.
* Ensure correct payroll integration and reporting of all benefit programs.



  





**Reporting \& Analytics** 



* Prepare payroll and compliance reports for HR, Finance, and Leadership teams.
* Conduct payroll reconciliations and variance analysis.
* Generate reports related to: Payroll costs, Headcount, Tax liabilities, Statutory obligations Compensation and benefit expenses
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and Total Rewards initiatives through payroll analytics.



  





**Payroll Systems \& Vendor Management** 



* Manage payroll operations using, ADP Global Payroll, ADP RUN
* Coordinate with payroll vendors, brokers, consultants, and statutory agencies.
* Drive continuous process improvements, automation, and payroll governance initiatives.



  





 Required Experience
 


* Minimum 5\+ years of dedicated International Payroll and Compliance experience in United States, United Arab Emirates.
* Minimum of 3 years of hands\-on experience working on both ADP Global Payroll and ADP RUN platforms
* United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia, Egypt will be added on advantage.
* Payroll taxation, Statutory filings and reporting, Employee benefits administration, Payroll audits and controls, Vendor management



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong knowledge of international payroll laws and regulations.
* In\-depth understanding of global payroll taxation and statutory compliance.
* Proficiency in payroll systems and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Advanced Excel and payroll reporting capabilities.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple geographies and competing priorities.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* High degree of integrity and confidentiality.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced global environment.

title: Researcher
description:
We are seeking a talented and analytically minded Specialist\-Research \& Market Intelligence to support our talent sourcing, recruitment strategy, and talent marketplace initiatives. This role focuses on market intelligence, competitive analysis, candidate behavior research, and talent ecosystem dynamics that inform our recruitment strategy, platform positioning, and talent marketplace expansion. You'll combine quantitative and qualitative research methodologies to deliver actionable insights that drive hiring effectiveness, candidate quality, and marketplace growth across geographies and verticals.
 



  





**Primary Responsibilities** 




**Talent Marketplace \& Recruitment Technology Competitive Analysis** 



* Conduct competitive landscape analysis of talent sourcing platforms.
* Track and analyze pricing models, feature releases, and market positioning of competing talent marketplaces
* Research emerging talent marketplace players, funding rounds, M\&A activity, and market consolidation patterns
* Identify white spaces in the talent marketplace ecosystem (underserved geographies, verticals, candidate segments)



**Recruitment Strategy \& Talent Sourcing Research** 



* Research and document emerging trends in talent sourcing strategies across industries and geographies
* Study talent acquisition best practices, hiring funnel optimization, and recruitment process automation
* Monitor employer branding strategies, EVP (Employer Value Proposition) positioning, and talent attraction trends
* Research skills gap analysis, high\-demand talent segments, and emerging skill requirements



**Candidate Behavior \& Demographic Research** 



* Analyze candidate preferences, job search behaviors, and platform engagement patterns
* Research demographic shifts in job seeking (age cohorts, geographic origins, education backgrounds)
* Research underrepresented talent pools and barriers to entry for diverse candidate segments
* Track candidate sentiment and satisfaction with recruitment experiences through surveys and social listening



**Talent Marketplace Performance Analytics** 



* Analyze marketplace metrics: candidate registrations, profile completion rates, employer adoption, placement rates
* Research talent pool quality, matching effectiveness, and placement success rates by geography and industry
* Create dashboards and KPIs tracking marketplace health, growth, and user engagement
* Conduct funnel analysis: sourcing → engagement → application → hire → retention
* Benchmark our marketplace performance against competitors and industry standards
* Identify drop\-off points and optimization opportunities in recruitment workflows



**Data Collection \& Analysis** 



* Design and deploy surveys to candidates, employers, university partners, and recruitment professionals
* Extract and analyze large datasets from talent marketplace platforms, ATS systems, and industry databases
* Create visualizations and infographics presenting talent market insights and recruitment trends
* Use tools like Excel, Python, SQL for data manipulation and statistical analysis



**Research Deliverables \& Strategic Insights** 



* Author talent marketplace research reports, market sizing studies, and competitive analyses
* Prepare executive summaries and board\-ready presentations on talent acquisition trends
* Develop research briefs for product, marketing, and partnership teams
* Create quarterly/annual talent market reports by geography, industry vertical, and skill category
* Contribute to thought leadership: industry publications, webinars, conference presentations
* Provide recommendations for marketplace feature priorities and expansion opportunities



**Ongoing Talent Market Monitoring** 



* Monitor talent marketplace industry publications, recruitment technology blogs, and HR research platforms
* Subscribe to talent acquisition intelligence services
* Build and maintain centralized talent market knowledge base with competitive intelligence
* Flag emerging opportunities and market threats for leadership review
* Track emerging talent marketplace players, new geographies, and expanding use cases

description:

 \- Confident and persuasive phone etiquette with a professional demeanor.
 




**\- 6months\- 1year** 

 of experience in customer support, telesales, or customer success only.
